notes.title: Version 1.1.0 Release
notes.content:
This version includes several small fixes and QoL changes.

Undead in the depths made more blind and also more visible to the player. This should make it easier to navigate those dark tunnels.

From Previous versions:

Fixed issue causing speed-runners not to trigger events occasionally.
Fixed a few capitalization issues.
FIxed an issue with a special bag appearing (or not appearing) unintentionally.
Fix issue with player being able to move sometimes when it was not intended.
Fixed graphics glitch in a particular spot.
April will no longer trap you against the wall.


Thank you for your feedback and contributions to making Black Chapter the best game possible.

notes.title: Version 1.0.5 Release
notes.content:
This version includes several small fixes and QoL changes.

Added some hints (no spoilers here!).
Made certain small objects much easier to interact with. Should nerf player frustration by 90%.
Fixed an issue with Emilie's name tag displaying the wrong name in a certain situation.
Fixed a few text-related errors (ex. succubuses -> succubi).
Fixed a bug with an unnecessary music pause near the end of the game.

This new version should fix all known bugs. If you find any other bugs, please post them on the bug thread.

Thank you for your feedback and contributions to making Black Chapter the best game possible.

notes.title: Black Chapter Release
notes.content:
Black Chapter is now officially released! Thank you all for your feedback and support!

We also did a round of fixes that should make gameplay a lot smoother.

[list]
[*] Reduced silence time in-game by around 40%. We received a lot of feedback about this. You'll be hearing the background soundtracks more often now. 
[*] Fixed an issue some people had with achievements
[*] Fixed bug which prevented a game over in the final discussion
[*] Improved follower pathing slightly
[*] Fixed an issue with music not playing after a game over
[*] Fixed bug that triggered the third discussion too early
[*] Few other small cosmetic bugfixes
[/list]

Thank you for your feedback and contributions to making Black Chapter the best game possible. If you find any bugs, please post them on the bug thread.

notes.title: Version 1.0.2 Release
notes.content:
This version fixes several small issues with the UI and improves hints.

Namely:
Fixed issue with name tag occassionally displaying the wrong name.
Fixed a few character expressions which were incorrect for the context.
Added hint for pausing and saving, which was not clear before.

Thank you for your feedback and contributions to making Black Chapter the best game possible. If you find any bugs, please post them on the bug thread.
